events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 405 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Possum Kingdom State Park to near
Breckenridge to Baird. Movement was northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Winds in excess of 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Breckenridge, Hubbard Creek Reservoir, Lake Daniel, Necessity,
Gunsight, Crystal Falls, Caddo, Palo Pinto Mountains State Park,
Possum Kingdom Lake, Eolian, Harpersville, and Ivan.

events.region: Northern Lake Including Gravelly Valley; Eastern Lake Including Clearlake and Middletown; Southern Lake Including Cobb and Konocti
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* AFFECTED AREA...Fire weather zones 418 including Lake Pillsbury,
419 including the City of Clearlake, Middletown, Lower Lake, and
Indian Valley Reservoir, and 420 including Cobb and Mount
Konocti.

* WIND...Sustained winds of 15 to 25mph with gusts to 35 mph
possible in exposed areas.

* HUMIDITY...Low overnight recoveries of 30-35% will drop to
10- 20% through the morning. Very poor RH recovery into
Friday.

* IMPACTS...any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Stephens County in north central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 700 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 401 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to slow
moving thunderstorms across central and northern Stephens County.
Radar estimates up to 2 inches of rain has fallen in the past
hour southwest of Breckenridge and near Ivan. Additional rainfall
amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible over the next few hours.
Overflowing poor drainage areas will cause minor flooding in the
advisory area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Breckenridge, Crystal Falls, Hubbard Creek Reservoir, Lake
Daniel, Caddo, Eolian, Ivan and Eliasville.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWSJT

The National Weather Service in San Angelo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Nolan County in west central Texas...
Southwestern Taylor County in west central Texas...

* Until 700 PM CDT.

* At 359 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Nolan, Happy Valley, Coronados Camp, Hylton, Camp Butman and Shep.

This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
FM 89 crossing Elm Creek, crossings along County Road 263, crossings
along County Road 357, County Road 196 crossing North Fork Valley
Creek, County Road 387 crossing Little Bitter Creek, crossings along
County Road 335, County Road 196 crossing North Fork Valley Creek,
crossings along County Road 283, crossings along County Road 301 and
County Road 263 crossing Fish Creek.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Haskell, TX; Jones, TX; Shackelford, TX; Throckmorton, TX
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Haskell County in west central Texas...
Southeastern Jones County in west central Texas...
Shackelford County in west central Texas...
Throckmorton County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 645 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 346 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Eastern Abilene, Stamford, Albany, Throckmorton, Lueders, Moran,
Woodson, Fort Griffin, Irby, Ibex, Millers Creek Reservoir,
Elbert, Lusk, Mccarty Lake, and the Big Country Baptist Assembly.
- This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
Loop Road crossing Paint Creek, County Road 274 crossing Brushy
Creek, County Road 279 crossing North Paint Creek, crossings
along County Road 117, County Road 122 crossing Indian Creek,
County Road 190 crossing Jenkins Creek, lake crossing Kings
Creek, crossings along County Road 374, crossings along County
Road 376 and crossings along County Road 334.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
